findings.current: 彼 — en: "they", pt: "eles" (ら tokenized separately as plural suffix)

findings.issue: "Try fixing it, okay." reads as an imperative addressed to the listener, but 直してみるよ is the speaker stating their own intention (matching en 'I'll try to fix it'). The literal mirror changes who performs the action.
findings.suggested: [I'll] fix it and see (= try fixing it), you know.

findings.suggested: Split into みな (todos; advérbio) + そこ (lá; destino marcado por へ)
